card.name: Fallback step after a failed first try
card.fires_on: The comma, "measures", "then" or "or else" at the end of an "if X fails/unresponsive" clause, just before a stronger fallback action is named.

modes.label: Unresponsive to measures
modes.description: The word "measures" ends an "if hypotension remains unresponsive to these conservative" clause, before a stronger treatment is named.
modes.example: If hypotension remains unresponsive to these conservative<< measures>>, consider administration of vasopressors

modes.label: Threat after failure
modes.description: A comma, "then" or "or else" in a conditional or ultimatum that leads to an imposed consequence.
modes.example: If the industry is unable to deliver<<,>> then an aggregates tax will be imposed.

modes.label: If necessary
modes.description: The word "necessary" in "if necessary", before a further step is advised.
modes.example: If<< necessary>>, seek some professional help.

card.writes: It pushes toward words of last resort or compulsion, such as resort, recourse and force.
card.plain: It marks the point where a first approach has failed and a stronger or forced next step is about to be named.
